newsitem.title: USA: Applied says wins patent case over Novellus.
newsitem.headline: Applied says wins patent case over Novellus.

text.p: Applied Materials Inc on Friday said a California jury has ruled that Novellus Systems Inc has infringed on a semiconductor processing patent held by Applied Materials.

The jury in the U.S. District Court for the Northern District of California found that Applied Materials' fundamental process patent for depositing dielectric layers between metal layers of a semiconductor chip, was infringed by systems sold by Novellus, Applied Said.
A separate trial will be held to determine damages, Applied said.
No one answered the telephone at Novellus' headquarters in San Jose, Calif., when efforts were made on Sunday to reach the company for comment on the reported verdict.
Applied said it will immediately seek an injunction to enforce the jury's verdict and to halt sales by Novellus of its Concept 1, Concept 2 and Maxus systems.
